latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the treatment in one native Goal. It created six source-linked findings and passed the preservation audit with no discrepancies. The final artifact is byte-identical to the mechanical projection (SHA-256 `8e4a129b…01d4ae2a`). Validation proposals are documented; no raster processing or product tests were run.

**Decision:** use valid-only majority when an output cell should represent the dominant class; use nearest when it should copy a representative source sample. Keep mask policy explicit, and report physical area only with an agreed CRS and area method.
